ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity white pixel coverage concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch on the distal right lobe containing internal low-intensity linear striations. Sparse high-intensity mottling and punctate spots on the distal left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes across the medial trailing edge. Distinct jagged peaks visible on the interior and exterior boundaries of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch, flattening toward the distal tips with a slight downward curve at the far right extremity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white circular clusters concentrated on the far right distal tip and sparse distribution across the lower medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct multiple parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white patch on the right lobe and several fine-line diagonal disruptions on the central black surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation/notch on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe. Visible calcified protrusions on the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-contrast white crescent-shaped marking on the distal edge of the left fluke lobe.
